rest_pose: Relaxed source A pose, outward feet; not a motion clip.

presentation_adapter.root_facing: Coordinator applies a single root yaw for MatchSnapshot -Z. Do not rotate individual meshes.
presentation_adapter.hand_target: PALM center, not wrist; use contact_contract.palms
presentation_adapter.authority: Never change physics/collisions to force these artistic proportions.

target_semantics.hand: Palm_L/R center of palmar skin, NOT Hand_L/R bone head (wrist)
target_semantics.ball_offset: Ball radius/contact offset belongs to the existing action target resolver; do not apply it twice here.
target_semantics.root_motion: Presentation only; no physical actor, collision or ball authority changes.

frame_convention.lateral: frame +X = up cross forward; right-handed frame, not an anatomical left/right label
frame_convention.matrix_format: Row-major JSON arrays acting on column vectors
frame_convention.bone_local: Blender bone rest basis, also the un-rebased glTF joint basis. Not actor XYZ.
frame_convention.importer_rebasis: If Godot rebases bones, reconstruct local locator as imported_bone_global_rest.inverse() * transform_gltf, within the imported model root before its MatchSnapshot yaw.

Palm_L.name: Palm_L
Palm_L.semantic: CENTER OF PALMAR SKIN SURFACE, not wrist and not ball center/radius
Palm_L.forward_definition: +Z wrist-to-mean-MCP direction projected onto the central palm tangent plane
Palm_L.up_definition: +Y smoothed geometric outward palmar normal, NOT world up or the back of the hand

authored_landmark.method: 80% wrist-to-mean-MCP projected onto central palmar skin; inspected against the actual hand, avoiding the proximal thenar pad

Palm_L.bone_field_definition: 'bone' remains Hand_L/R, the anchor of transform_bone_local_rows; helper_bone is the new actual Palm joint.

Palm_R.name: Palm_R
Palm_R.semantic: CENTER OF PALMAR SKIN SURFACE, not wrist and not ball center/radius
Palm_R.forward_definition: +Z wrist-to-mean-MCP direction projected onto the central palm tangent plane
Palm_R.up_definition: +Y smoothed geometric outward palmar normal, NOT world up or the back of the hand

authored_landmark.method: 80% wrist-to-mean-MCP projected onto central palmar skin; inspected against the actual hand, avoiding the proximal thenar pad

Palm_R.bone_field_definition: 'bone' remains Hand_L/R, the anchor of transform_bone_local_rows; helper_bone is the new actual Palm joint.

Foot_L.name: BootFrame_L
Foot_L.forward_definition: +Z towards the modeled toe, parallel to the sole plane
Foot_L.up_definition: +Y away from the floor, Blender +Z / glTF +Y at rest
Foot_L.note: Distances use the boot's own forward axis, not raw actor Z in this outward-foot rest pose. Do not rescale anatomy to hide these deltas.

Foot_R.name: BootFrame_R
Foot_R.forward_definition: +Z towards the modeled toe, parallel to the sole plane
Foot_R.up_definition: +Y away from the floor, Blender +Z / glTF +Y at rest
Foot_R.note: Distances use the boot's own forward axis, not raw actor Z in this outward-foot rest pose. Do not rescale anatomy to hide these deltas.

kit_mask_binding.representation: Blender COLOR0 -> glTF COLOR_0 -> Godot COLOR, linear RGBA data
kit_mask_binding.encoding: FLOAT_COLOR authoring; RGBA normalized per exported vertex

channels.G: shorts + existing narrow secondary jersey side panels

kit_mask_binding.transfer_method: Bilinear sampling of the existing PNG in UV0 at each mesh corner, then normalization; secondary jersey side panels preserved.
kit_mask_binding.generic_material_warning: COLOR_0 is mask DATA, not ordinary albedo or opacity. Use the coordinator's kit shader; a generic glTF viewer may display mask colors.
